pausedSub: Dinani kapena kanikizani Enter kuti mupitirize.
emptySub: Onjezani zina m'masewerawa kuti athe kuseweredwa.
copyFail: Mawuwo asankhidwa. Wakopereni ndi Ctrl kapena Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Masewera a dziko lotseguka. Yendayendani ndi munthuyo. Malingaliro adzakutsutsani ndi mafunso.
stageHow: Yendani ndi mivi kapena W A S D. Kanikizani N kuti mupite ku nyumba yotsatira. Lingaliro likaoneka, kanikizani 1 mpaka 4 kapena Tab ndi Enter kuti muyankhe. Kanikizani Tab kuti mupitirize. Mawu onse alinso pansi pa Werengani popanda kusewera.
hintKeys: Mivi kapena WASD poyenda. N kwa nyumba yotsatira.
hintTouch: Gwirani mapu kapena gwiritsani ntchito mabatani
guideText: Yendayendani. Malingaliro adzakupezani, kapena gogodani nyumba yotsekedwa kuti mukumane ndi limodzi.
knockedOut: Wagwetsedwa! Wathawa. Mitima yanu yabwerera, choncho yesaninso.
knockedDialog: {name} wathawa. Gogodani nyumba yake kuti mukumanenso naye.
